StatisticalAlone.description:
N-19l (code review R6-05; D-68 as amended): what the statistical checks alone decided, in a result that a
provenance record decides beside a statistical estimate. The page and the reports take the form of the number from
here where the record did not set it: the large numeral only where the checks alone decide. `code`: the code the
result would have without the record. `unsupported`: D-76 took a decisive code of the estimate away, and the side
of the answer that no check supports (toward AI generation or manipulation, or away from it). `rule` (N-19m; D-77,
D-76 as amended): the condition that took the decisive code, as the stage's output names it: `scale` (D-77: the
estimate stands outside the part of the scale of the levels' answer: in the middle part, or under a configured prior
in the other answer's; no side), `no_check` (D-76: no single check supports the answer),
`together_less` and `together_against` (D-76: a check supports it, and the checks together give it less than weak
support, or point the other way). A result stored before N-19m names no condition and reads as `no_check`.
StatisticalAlone.title: StatisticalAlone

so the upload is never held in process memory. The analysis gets an implicit case (C-2).

get.description: Liveness: this process answers. It asks nothing else: not the database, not the data volume, not a worker (N-13).

The Prometheus text exposition, read from the database at scrape time, so every process of an instance gives the same
answer (N-13): the queue, the analyses, the worker's heartbeat, the data volume, version and build commit.

Readiness: 200 with `status: ready` when the database can be written, the data directory can be written and its volume
is above the free-space floor and a worker serves the queue (its heartbeat, when this process runs none); else 503 with
`not_ready`.

A caller without credentials is told the `status` only. With credentials the body adds `checks` (each with `ok`, and
why it failed), `version`, `build_commit`, `queue_depth` and what the serving worker runs on: `device`, `profile`,
`loaded` models, and per analysis kind `fusion` (`artefact` or `fallback`), `fusers` (version, the start of the sha256,
review state) and `text_classifier`; with `profile`, what serves under that profile.

Analyses, newest first. `decision` filters on the decision code, `hypothesis` on the driving hypothesis;
`awaiting_second_review=true` gives the revisions an examiner has signed on a case that requires a second review and
that no peer has reviewed yet (a reviewer's queue), `false` every other one. A non-administrator sees the analyses of
its cases only (C-2).
Summary, decision, assessments, condition profile, coverage and manifest (no exhibit payloads).
One assessment per hypothesis (H2 lane assessments are nested in `lanes`).
